title: Permit Registry Model
description: Permits issued by authorities, with their conditions.
$comment: PermitRegistry 1.1.0 (draft). Backward compatible with 1.0.0: every valid 1.0.0 document is valid against this schema. Because content is closed, 1.0.0 validators reject documents that use the new 1.1.0 properties; send 1.0.0 consumers the 1.0.0 projection (see exports/1.1.0/compatibility.md).

PermitStatus.description: Lifecycle status of a permit as decided by the authority. Expiry is not a status value; it is derived from validUntil/validUntilTime.

ConditionCategory.description: Kind of obligation a permit condition imposes.

Applicant.description: Person or organisation that applied for a permit. Contains personal data.

name.description: Name of the applicant (person or contact person).

organisation.description: Organisation on whose behalf the application was made.

Authority.description: Public body competent to issue permits.

Permit.description: Official authorisation granted to an applicant for an activity at a site.

reference.description: Human-readable file number used by the authority ("fileNumber"). Property name kept as 'reference' for compatibility.
reference.title: File number

applicant.description: Applicant of the permit. Mandatory for permits registered from the CR-7 cut-over on; may be absent for older permits.

validUntil.description: Last day on which the permit is valid.

validUntilTime.description: Local time of day (time zone of the issuing authority) at which the permit expires on validUntil. Absent = end of day. Only allowed together with validUntil.

keywords.description: Deprecated since 1.1.0, to be removed in 2.0.0. Producers should not populate it.

Permit.$comment: C-001: validUntil must not be before decisionDate. C-002: permits registered on/after the CR-7 cut-over must have an applicant (not expressible here; enforced by the registering system). C-003: validUntilTime requires validUntil (dependentRequired).
